summary: Getter that reads two consecutive DWORD fields (offset 0x38 and 0x3C) from the this struct and writes each to a caller-supplied output pointer when that pointer is non-null. Returns the second output pointer a3. Both struct reads are unconditional; only the stores are null-guarded. Called by eleven frame-path functions (camera, car-selection, steering/camera-follow, 2D transform copy and numeric helpers).

operations.description: Guard on output pointer a2: only write the first field value when a2 is non-null.
Seed the return value with output pointer a3.
Guard on output pointer a3: only write the second field value when a3 is non-null.
Return a3, the second caller-supplied output pointer.

unresolved: Semantic meaning of the two DWORD fields (0x38, 0x3C) is unknown; the eleven frame-path callers suggest a per-frame camera/viewport or transform quantity, unproven here.
Whether the caller may pass the same output pointer for both fields is not constrained by this function.
